content: For Synchronized and Offset Time Bases for which the StbM is configured as Time Gateway, the StbM shall set the SYNC_TO_GATEWAY bit within timeBaseStatus of the Time Base when a timeout occurs (refer to [SWS_StbM_00183] ) .

For Synchronized and Offset Time Bases for which the StbM is configured as Time Gateway, the StbM shall set the SYNC_TO_GATEWAY bit within timeBaseStatus of the Time Base when a timeout occurs (refer to [SWS_StbM_00183] ) .

For Synchronized and Offset Time Bases for which the StbM is configured as Time Gateway, the StbM shall set the SYNC_TO_GATEWAY bit within timeBaseStatus of the Time Base when a timeout occurs (refer to [SWS_StbM_00183] ) .
